channel.title: UNICEF Job Vacancies (Filtered)
channel.description: Filtered UNICEF job vacancies: Professional (P-1 to P-5), Director (D-1/D-2), internships and fellowships.

item.title: Chief Field Office, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Mekelle, Ethiopia, #00116531 (For non-Ethiopian nationals only)
item.description: Join our team at UNICEF Ethiopia to manage and lead the total programme commitment of a field office within a country programme.

item.title: Procurement Services Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Ethiopia, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, #00096880
item.description: Join our team at UNICEF Ethiopia to manage the complex and large Procurement Services (PS) function.

item.title: New Internship Recruitment - Emergency Preparedness Platform (EPP 3.0) Implementation, EMOPS, Rome
item.description: We are looking for a dynamic and dedicated person to support the continuous improvement and effective use of EPP 3.0 through functional testing, issue documentation, user support and preparedness-related activities. The intern will contribute to platform quality by identifying bugs, validating new functionality, supporting the translation of user feedback into Product Backlog Items (PBIs), and assisting with testing and operational support to ensure the platform continues to meet UNICEF's preparedness needs.

item.title: Senior Advisor (Economic and Social Policy and Gender Equality), P-5, Fixed Term Position, Programme Group, #00133884
item.description: The Senior Advisor (Economic & Social Policy and Gender Equality) provides strategic leadership to integrate gender equality and adolescent girls' empowerment into economic and social policies, particularly in areas like child poverty reduction and social protection. Through policy advisory, thought leadership, capacity building, and accountability to the Gender Action Plan, the role ensures gender-sensitive approaches are embedded across UNICEF’s programming and partnerships.

item.title: Emergency Manager (P-5), TA, 364 days, #00138189, Caracas – Venezuela, LACR
item.description: UNICEF Venezuela is seeking a seasoned Emergency Manager to lead the Country Office's response to one of the most demanding humanitarian operations in the region. Reporting directly to the Representative, you will set the strategic direction for emergency preparedness and response, provide technical leadership across sectors, and represent UNICEF at the highest levels of coordination with Government, the UN Country Team, and the humanitarian cluster system. This is a role for a proven crisis leader — someone who has led response operations before, knows how to build and steer a team under pressure, and is ready to shape both the immediate response and the long-term recovery architecture for children and families affected by the earthquake. If you're looking for a posting where your seniority, judgment and leadership will define the outcome for thousands of children, this is it.

item.title: Emergency Specialist (P-3), TA, 364 days, #00138190, Caracas – Venezuela, LACR
item.description: Venezuela is currently responding to a major earthquake emergency in its central-northern region, and UNICEF is looking for an experienced Emergency Specialist ready to make a real difference on the ground. This is a opportunity to lead emergency preparedness and response efforts at the heart of the operation — from rapid needs assessments and coordination with Government, UN agencies and NGOs, to mobilizing resources and ensuring life-saving assistance reaches children and families when they need it most. If you thrive under pressure, bring proven field experience from complex emergencies, and want your work to translate directly into impact for the most vulnerable children, this is your moment. Join a dedicated team already on the ground in Venezuela and help shape the next phase of this critical response.

item.title: Business Analyst (UNITE), P-3, Temporary Position, 364 days, Office of Strategy & Evidence, Innocenti, Florence, Italy #00136560
item.description: To ensure the successful delivery of the UNITE system, a temporary appointment is required to support the development and implementation of the UNITE project. This role serves as a bridge between business stakeholders, DID and the vendor, ensuring that business requirements are clearly understood and addressed.

item.title: Planning & Monitoring Specialist (P-3), TA, 8 months, #00138172, Bujumbura, Burundi
item.description: UNICEF Burundi is seeking a highly qualified, motivated, and results-oriented Planning and Monitoring Specialist (P-3) to support the Country Office in strengthening programme planning, monitoring, and results-based management. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly independent and analytical professional who is committed to excellence, accountability, and the delivery of meaningful and sustainable results for children and communities in Burundi.The Planning and Monitoring Specialist will provide technical expertise and coordination support to enhance the quality, coherence, and effectiveness of planning and monitoring systems across the Country Office.

item.title: Chief Nutrition, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Lilongwe, Malawi, #00052247
item.description: UNICEF seeks an experienced Chief of Nutrition to lead UNICEF Malawi’s comprehensive nutrition portfolio, providing strategic direction, technical leadership and partnership coordination to strengthen nutrition systems and deliver sustainable results for children, adolescents and women across development and humanitarian contexts.

item.title: Programme Specialist (Safeguarding), P-3, TA, 364 days, #00138203, Education Cannot Wait (ECW), UNICEF Hosted Fund, Geneva, Switzerland
item.description: Education Cannot Wait (ECW) is looking for a highly motivated Programme Specialist (Safeguarding) to support and strengthen ECW’s safeguarding work across its global humanitarian education portfolio. Under the general guidance and supervision of the Chief of Education, the incumbent will play a critical role within the Programme Delivery and Quality Team, conducting Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) assessments of partner organizations, managing safeguarding incidents and concerns involving partners, and supporting safeguarding capacity-strengthening initiatives. Working closely with colleagues across the Programme Delivery and Quality, Finance, Risk & Operations, Evidence, Results and Reporting, and Partnerships, Advocacy and Resource Mobilization teams, the Programme Specialist will also engage with UNICEF colleagues through cross-divisional safeguarding forums and collaborate with ECW-funded partners to promote safe, accountable and child-centered programming.

item.title: Social & Behavior Change Specialist (Digital Communication) (P-3), TA, #138206, Islamabad – Pakistan, APR, 4 months (Open for International Candidates Only)
item.description: UNICEF Pakistan is looking for a passionate and results-driven Social & Behavior Change Specialist (Digital Communication) to join our Pakistan Polio team.If you're passionate about harnessing the power of digital communication to inspire behavior change and improve the lives of children, this is your opportunity to make a real impact. At UNICEF, we are committed to eradicating polio through sustained immunization efforts, meaningful community engagement, and evidence-based health communication. In this role, you will help strengthen UNICEF's digital presence, build public trust and support, and contribute to achieving lasting results for every child in Pakistan.Join us and be part of a team that's creating a healthier, safer future for every child.

item.title: Risk Manager, (P-4), TA, 364 days, #00138191, Caracas – Venezuela, LACR
item.description: Under the supervision of the Representative, the Risk and Compliance Manager will be responsible for leading the strengthening of risk assurance and compliance efforts in the context of the Venezuela country office. He/She will be responsible for providing complementary expertise, support, and monitoring related to the management of risk, including but not limited to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of risk management practices at a process, systems, and entity level.

item.title: Chief (Risk Analysis and Preparedness), P-5, Fixed Term Position, #00107500, Office of Emergency Operations, Outposted to Rome, Italy
item.description: We are looking for a dedicating Chief, who supports the Deputy Director in corporate decision-making and prioritization processes, ensuring that risks are systematically identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable recommendations for resource allocation, preparedness investment, and early action. The Chief, Risk Analysis and Preparedness also supervises the Risk and Preparedness Unit, a small team of professionals working on risk analysis and preparedness within EMOPS.

item.title: Health and Nutrition Policy Advocacy Intern, Beijing, UNICEF China, 6 months (Onsite, for Chinese nationals only)
item.description: UNICEF China is seeking a highly motivated Health and Nutrition Policy Advocacy Intern to support evidence generation, policy research, and stakeholder engagement on child health and nutrition priorities. The intern will contribute to real-world policy initiatives, working alongside UNICEF specialists, government counterparts, researchers, and development partners to advance more supportive health and nutrition policy environments for children.

item.title: Consultor para estrategia de SBC de Primera Infancia, Programme Effectiveness, Quito, Ecuador - Remoto, 7 meses, Nacional
item.description: Diseñar una metodología de cambio social y de comportamiento, para el desarrollo integral de la primera infancia, con el fin de promover prácticas y entornos favorables para la primera infancia de manera sostenible. Objetivos específicos ● Identificar los principales determinantes conductuales y barreras sociales en el entorno de la primera infancia para diseñar una metodología de cambio social y de comportamiento adaptada al contexto local. ● Diseñar un plan piloto de aplicación de la metodología en articulación con las entidades competentes, a fin de determinar su operatividad, pertinencia y capacidad de adaptación a distintos contextos. ● Evaluar el proceso con un análisis técnico y participativo, incorporando lecciones aprendidas y recomendaciones para ajustar y optimizar la metodología con miras a su escalamiento en diferentes contextos y temáticas.

item.title: Chief Planning & Monitoring, P-4, FT, #112427, Freetown - Sierra Leone, WCAR
item.description: UNICEF Sierra Leone is seeking to recruit a Chief of Planning and Monitoring. The Chief of Planning and Monitoring will lead monitoring and evaluation activities, knowledge management for evidence-based analysis and HACT adherence as an integral part of programme development, planning and implementation.

item.title: Research Officer (Digital), P-2, Temporary Position 364 days, Florence, Italy, Office of Strategy & Evidence - Innocenti, #00138231 (Remote - Home Based)
item.description: Under guidance of the Research Specialist, Digital Engagement and Protection, the Research Officer (Digital) will mainly be responsible for leading statistical analysis of survey data related to technology-facilitated sexual exploitation and abuse, as well as supporting the quantitative research design for the inception phase of a new longitudinal research project. Support will also be needed for mixed-methods integration and analysis related to the unit’s qualitative research under these projects, with support from the supervisor and team members. The Research Officer will draft various publications, including research reports, policy briefs and/or journal articles, using primary and/or secondary data to respond to strategic priorities and dialogue within UNICEF and globally related to children’s digital engagement and protection.

item.title: Content Marketing Intern (AI-focused), Beijing, UNICEF China (For Chinese Nationals Only)
item.description: UNICEF China is seeking a full-time intern for a 6-month, on-site internship in the Partnership and Innovation Section to support the Marketing team in developing AI-driven content creation workflows for digital fundraising. The intern will contribute to prompt engineering, knowledge base development, AI-assisted content production, and performance monitoring, while gaining practical experience in AI applications, digital marketing, and fundraising within an international organization.

item.title: Programme Budget Specialist, P-3, Fixed Term Position, Copenhagen, Supply Division, #00102939
item.description: The position is situated in the Procurement Services Accounting and Reporting, Accounting Unit (PSARU) of the Financial Management and Administrative Centre in UNICEF's Supply Division. PSARU is responsible for financial management of GAVI and Procurement Services Partners’ procurement services operations focused on procurement of vaccines and vaccine-related supplies for GAVI eligible and Procurement Services countries.

item.title: Partnerships Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Kyiv, Ukraine, post#120444
item.description: The Partnerships Manager is an authoritative expert in the field of external relations, in particular partnership development and resource mobilization. The quality of work and external communications performed by the Manager directly impacts on the overall reputation of UNICEF.They are accountable for (a) mobilizing and leveraging resources, (b) contributing to strategy planning (c) identifying and building effective partnerships with member states, international financial institutions, private sector, UN agencies, NGOs and host government (d) providing advice to UNICEF based on analysis of current political and social events and information of programme activities gathered from partner agencies.

item.title: Contracts Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Copenhagen, Denmark, Supply Division, #00137879
item.description: The role is expected to drive tangible improvements in access to essential medicines including pediatric cancer medicines by enhancing their availability and affordability, while application of the Healthy Markets Framework. The incumbent will contribute to building sustainable market shaping activities that support long-term, equitable access to essential medicines for children, in line with UNICEF’s global mandate. Effective management of the partnership will strengthen GPACCM delivery, improve partner satisfaction, and ensure alignment between technical implementation and partnership commitments, contributing to sustainable and scalable access models.

item.title: Chief Social Policy, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Fiji (Pacific Islands) - MCP, Pacific Office, Suva, Fiji, #00064877
item.description: Pacific Multi-Country Office is looking for an experienced Social Policy professional who is excited by challenges and who wants to achieve meaningful and tangible results for children in the Pacific. The Chief Social Policy is a pivotal role within PCMO, leading, managing and supervising all stages of social policy programming and related advocacy from strategic planning and formulation to delivery of concrete and sustainable results. As a key figure, you will lead a dedicated team of staff members, providing solution-oriented innovation and in-time delivery.

item.title: Emergency Specialist, P-3, Temporary Position, #00137994, O/P Rome, Italy, Office of Emergency Operations, Off of Emergency Prog, HQ
item.description: We are looking for the dedicated Emergency Specialist (Anticipatory Action), who will be responsible for leading the management and implementation of the insurance-backed anticipatory action (AA) programme.

item.title: Re-Advertisement: Chief WASH, P-5, Fixed Term Position, Kyiv, Ukraine, #00101336
item.description: The Chief of WASH will provide the leadership needed to enable the Country Office to achieve the WASH-related output results of the country programme. This, in turn, will contribute to the achievement of the outcome results of the Country Programme Document. When done effectively, the achievement of the outcome results will improve child survival, growth and development and reduce inequalities in the country.

item.title: Partnerships Officer, P-2, Temporary Position, 364 days, Innovative Finance HUB O/P Helsinki, #00138177
item.description: Short free text, that is visible in TMS without opening the actual VA on the job portal. It is not part of the branded VA, but it is needed in the VA front page.

item.title: Supply & Logistics Specialist, P-3, Fixed Term Position, Pacific Islands - MCP, Pacific Office, Suva, Fiji, #00113994
item.description: Pacific Multi-Country Office is looking for an experienced Supply & Procurement professional who is excited by challenges and who wants to achieve meaningful and tangible results for children in the Pacific. The Supply and Logistics Specialist is a pivotal role within PCMO, ensuring the optimal delivery of UNICEF resources to 14 countries across a wide geographic area, including 5 field offices and 7 warehouses, across the Pacific countries and Australia. As a key figure, you will lead a dedicated team of 5 staff members, providing solution-oriented innovation and in-time delivery.

item.title: Chief Child Protection, P-5, Fixed Term Position, Suva, Fiji (Pacific Islands) - MCP, 24 months, #00043777
item.description: Lead high-level policy dialogue and technical engagement with national and international partners, promoting evidence-based approaches that strengthen child protection systems, advance equity, and improve outcomes for children and adolescents. By providing expert technical guidance, you will be influencing national agendas, and ensuring strong preparedness and response mechanisms to protect children in both development and emergency contexts, while creating lasting social change and safeguarding children.

item.title: Consultoria Nacional o Internacional, para el fortalecimiento de competencias blandas, UNICEF-Nicaragua, Remoto, 6 meses.
item.description: Esta consultoría es para el apoyo técnico especializado para realizar e implementar un plan de fortalecimiento de las competencias blandas del personal de UNICEF en Nicaragua.

item.title: Consultoría sistematización de la gestión de desechos sólidos y de agua, saneamiento e higiene (ASH) en los Establecimientos de Salud del primer Nivel de Atención, WASH y CEED, 4 meses, Tegucigalpa, Remota,
item.description: Desarrollar Sistematización para la gestión adecuada de desechos sólidos y de servicios agua, saneamiento e higiene (ASH), en el marco conceptual de WASHFIT1 (Herramienta para el mejoramiento progresivo de servicios de ASH, de UNICEF y OMS), recopilando y analizando buenas prácticas, brechas y recomendaciones para contribuir a procesos de estandarización y fortalecimiento de los Establecimientos de Salud (ES), así como para favorecer el escalamiento de dichas prácticas a nivel nacional, en el marco de las políticas de salud del Gobierno de Honduras.

item.title: Investigation Manager, P-4, FTA, Office of Internal Audit & Investigation, Nairobi, Kenya, #00103395
item.description: Under the overall supervision and guidance of the Chief of the Investigations Unit, and based in Nairobi, the Investigation Manager carries out investigations into allegations of fraud, abuse of authority, mismanagement, harassment, sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse and/or retaliatory actions in or affecting UNICEF, and makes recommendations for corrective action and improved controls. The incumbent also provides day-to-day management and technical oversight, including through matrix management arrangements, of specialist investigative capacity as assigned.

item.title: Social & Behavior Change Specialist, P-3, Fixed Term Position, #00137802, Port Moresby - Papua N. Guinea, APR (Open for international candidates only)
item.description: Under the supervision of Chief of Health and Nutrition and in collaboration with other relevant programme colleagues, responsible for the design, formulation, management, execution, monitoring and evaluation of a behavioral change and social mobilization strategy, plan of action and programme activities in support of the SBC component of the country programme.

item.title: Chief Social Policy, (P-4), FT, #058657, Cotonou - Benin, WCAR
item.description: Benin is a middle-income country that faces many challenges in guaranteeing the rights of everychild. Ranked 158th out of 191 countries on the Human Development Index (UNDP, 2021/2022), ithas significant disparities between urban and rural areas, and between girls and boys. Since 1977,UNICEF has been working closely with the government, civil society, technical and financialpartners, young people and communities to improve access to education, health services,protection, water, sanitation, nutrition and social policies for children.The 2024-2026 cooperation program pays particular attention to girls' education, protectionagainst violence, community health, and the fight against child labor. Present in the field throughits offices in Cotonou, Natitingou and Parakou, UNICEF is committed to working alongside themost vulnerable communities to guarantee concrete, lasting results.Social Policy is a standalone section.

item.title: Programme Specialist (Mental Health and Psychosocial Support), P-3, TA (364 days), #137950, MCP, Pacific Office, Suva, Fiji (Pacific Islands) - EAPR
item.description: Join UNICEF as a Programme Specialist (Mental Health and Psychosocial Support), P-3 in Suva, Fiji, and play a critical role in strengthening the mental health and wellbeing of children and adolescents across the Pacific. This dynamic position offers the opportunity to lead and coordinate multi-country MHPSS initiatives, work closely with governments,, civil society and faith based organizations to d drive practical solutions to address pressing challenges Ideal for a passionate professional with strong expertise in mental health, child protection, and capacity building, the role provides a unique platform to design and implement interventions, influence policy and systems strengthening, and promote cross-sectoral collaboration. Working within UNICEF’s Pacific Multi-Country Office, you will contribute to sustainable, evidence-based programmes while gaining valuable experience in a culturally rich and diverse island region.

item.title: Comptroller and Director, Division of Finance and Management - (D-2), FT, NYHQ, USA
item.description: UNICEF is looking to hire Comptroller and Director, Division of Finance and Management. The Division of Financial and Administrative Management (DFAM) under the leadership of the UNICEF Comptroller is looking for a dynamic leader responsible for maintaining a sound system of internal controls and leading financial reforms; budget formulation and planning, including performance and financial risk management; and the establishment of systems to ensure effective and efficient use of resources and the safeguarding of UNICEF assets.

item.title: Readvertisment - Operationalization of Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI), Tarawa, Kiribati/ Health and Nutrition, 4.7 months (office based with trip, ONLY INTERNATIONAL)
item.description: This assignment will support the Ministry of Health and Medical Services (MHMS) to strengthen and institutionalise the Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) across Kiribati, with a particular focus on ensuring sustainability, quality of care, and responsiveness to emerging climate and outbreak related child health risks. The work will contribute to improved neonatal and child health outcomes by updating national guidance, building a sustainable training and mentoring system, integrating IMNCI into pre-service education, and supporting initial operationalisation of IMNCI services in selected facilities.

item.title: WASH Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Islamabad, Pakistan, #00041027
item.description: UNICEF is seeking a WASH Manager (P4) to support the management and delivery of a large and complex WASH programme. Reporting to the Chief of WASH/CEE, the role provides technical guidance, programme oversight, and quality assurance to ensure effective implementation of WASH interventions and sustainable results for children and communities. The position also engages with government and partners at senior levels to advance UNICEF's equity-focused mission.

item.title: Deputy Representative Operations, (P-4) Fixed Term – Hanoi,Vietnam #1368
item.description: An exciting and challenging opportunity is now available within the UNICEF Vietnam Country Office for a highly motivated and dedicated Deputy Representative, Operations (P-4). The Operations function is a strategic Business Partner role within the Senior Management Team, assuring the best use of UNICEF assets in alignment with sound management practices, office priorities and goals to deliver results for children. The function supports the Head of the Office on managing the office and monitoring operations and programmes as needed while providing advice on best and innovative management practices to enhance office performance.

item.title: Director, Evaluation Office (D-2), Rome, Italy
item.description: UNICEF is seeking to hire a new Director of Evaluation. The Director of Evaluation reports directly to the Executive Director and heads the Evaluation Office that is functionally independent within the organization. The Director of Evaluation enables organizational learning, accountability and performance improvement by spearheading intellectual and organizational leadership and strategic guidance for the evaluation function. The Director leads and manages the staff of the Evaluation Office and is accountable for the performance of the Office.
